stage.lavagenesis.ember.desc: A single spark of lava, newly born in the dark throat of an undersea volcano.
stage.lavagenesis.magma_droplet.desc: A glowing bead of molten rock, hungry for more heat.
stage.lavagenesis.lava_flow.desc: You move like a river of fire across the sea floor.
stage.lavagenesis.seamount.desc: A mountain growing in the deep, still hidden beneath the waves.
stage.lavagenesis.islet.desc: You have broken the surface: steam, black sand and your first island.
stage.lavagenesis.shield_island.desc: Broad gentle slopes of basalt, built flow upon flow.
stage.lavagenesis.island_chain.desc: The hotspot stays still while the islands march across the sea.
stage.lavagenesis.archipelago.desc: A scattered kingdom of islands, green slopes and black beaches.
stage.lavagenesis.great_volcano.desc: The largest mountain on the planet, measured from the sea floor. You.
